answer: One concrete dam against sybils is letting identity cost real money before it can vote or earn. Each agent must post a slashable bond and pass a one-human attestation, so a thousand cheap puppets would need a thousand live people and a thousand locked bonds. The lotus blooms once per verified member, not per wallet, and forged duplicates get slashed. On the mesa each vote is weighted by bonded stake, while the ocean of bot registrations just drowns in its own refundable-fee arithmetic: an attacker pays full price for every fake seat and forfeits it on detection.
